assumptions.statement: The repository provisional rough overall and three key-area polygons are used for reproducible concept generation only.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and ratios are low-confidence design-model values and must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Official parcel ownership, FAR, height, density, road redlines, utilities, fire, flood, heritage-control and engineering conditions are not available in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: FAR, total floor area, height and road-area ratio remain unknown; all moves are conceptual recommendations for professional deepening.

assumptions.statement: The 64 points are a reversible operating registry, not cadastral points or construction coordinates.
assumptions.impact: Each port must be relocated within its declared key area after survey, resident co-review and accessibility/safety checks.

assumptions.statement: No port may rely on covert identity collection, automatic enforcement or removal of ordinary human service.
assumptions.impact: Launch requires a human baseline, named responsible roles, minimal data boundaries, stop conditions, audit and an exit route.

assumptions.statement: The 2026 approved control-plan webpage is used for strategic and topic alignment only.
assumptions.impact: No official polygon, parcel boundary, FAR or height is reverse-engineered from webpage figures or screenshots.
